[[File:Joe Sottile DecipherCon 1999.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Sealed Deck at [[DecipherCon 1999]]. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Joe Sottile''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Massachusetts State Championship]] on 29 April 2000 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base no flip Y-wings/Odds/Retrieval]], according to Michael Hawley's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d645">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-01-massachusetts-states-boxboro-4-29-00d645/ massachusetts-states-boxboro-4-29-00], DeckTech (Michael "rayc" Hawley, 1 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-01-massachusetts-states-boxboro-4-29-00d645/ GitHub Pages]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026170254/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-01-massachusetts-states-boxboro-4-29-00d645/ Internet Archive].</ref>
